permission.name: TipoExpediente.conAce
permission.condition: self IN ( SELECT aa.tipoExpediente FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.security.db.Ace aa WHERE aa.tipoExpediente IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT cu FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuario cu WHERE cu.usuario = ? AND (aa.centro IS NULL OR aa.centro = cu.centro) AND ( aa.centroUsuario = cu OR aa.tipoUsuario IN (SELECT cut.tipoUsuario FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuarioTipoUsuario cut WHERE cut.centroUsuario = cu) OR aa.cargo IN (SELECT cuc.cargo FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuarioCargo cuc WHERE cuc.centroUsuario = cu) ) ) )

permission.name: Tramite.creador
permission.condition: self IN ( SELECT aa.tramite FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.security.db.Ace aa WHERE aa.perfil.name = 'CREADOR' AND aa.tramite IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT cu FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuario cu WHERE cu.usuario = ? AND (aa.centro IS NULL OR aa.centro = cu.centro) AND ( aa.centroUsuario = cu OR aa.tipoUsuario IN (SELECT cut.tipoUsuario FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuarioTipoUsuario cut WHERE cut.centroUsuario = cu) OR aa.cargo IN (SELECT cuc.cargo FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuarioCargo cuc WHERE cuc.centroUsuario = cu) ) ) )

permission.name: Tramite.porTramite
permission.condition: self IN ( SELECT aa.tramite FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.security.db.Ace aa WHERE aa.tramite IS NOT NULL AND aa.perfil.name != 'CREADOR' AND EXISTS ( SELECT cu FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuario cu WHERE cu.usuario = ? AND (aa.centro IS NULL OR aa.centro = cu.centro) AND ( aa.centroUsuario = cu OR aa.tipoUsuario IN (SELECT cut.tipoUsuario FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuarioTipoUsuario cut WHERE cut.centroUsuario = cu) OR aa.cargo IN (SELECT cuc.cargo FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuarioCargo cuc WHERE cuc.centroUsuario = cu) ) ) )

permission.name: Tramite.registrador
permission.condition: self.defaultTipoExpediente IS NOT NULL AND self.tipoTramite.admitePresentacionEnPapel = true AND EXISTS ( SELECT cu FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuario cu WHERE cu.usuario = ? AND ( EXISTS (SELECT cut FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuarioTipoUsuario cut WHERE cut.centroUsuario = cu AND cut.tipoUsuario MEMBER OF self.tipoTramite.tiposUsuarioRegistradores) OR EXISTS (SELECT cuc FROM com.educaflow.subsystem.common.db.CentroUsuarioCargo cuc WHERE cuc.centroUsuario = cu AND cuc.cargo MEMBER OF self.tipoTramite.cargosRegistradores) ) )
